doc: Flat billboard arrowhead: one unlit triangle per head, its direction resolved in view space and all three vertices sharing the tip's depth. `cull` is "none" by choice, not necessity, since `perp` is always `dir` rotated the same way and the winding is constant; tests/test_arrow_flat.py::test_the_triangle_winding_does_not_depend_on_the_direction finds all eight directions drawn under back-face culling and none under front-face. Nothing is won by culling one triangle per arrow, and the wrong sense makes every head invisible at once.
